corpus_note: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II Section 3(i), No. 124, G.S.R. 202(E) dated 7 March 2011) have been ingested from the official gazette PDF supplied by the user. The English text of the notification (pages 37-83 of the gazette) was extracted and every rule record below carries a verbatim excerpt in exact_requirement together with its rule number. The Hindi portion (pages 1-36) is the same notification and was not separately ingested. No amendment notification after 2011 has been supplied; therefore the engine applies the principal rules as published, and no post-2011 amendment is modelled.
